en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Murazim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Revealed in the Quran an explanation of everything to the extent that, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not neglect anything which the servants would be needy to, until there is no capacity for a servant to be saying, ‘If only this (matter) had been Revealed in the Quran’, except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Revealed in it’.
